work.title: Tag on Robbo Mural
work.description: Outdoor wall mural featuring a masked female figure with gold teeth and a red bow, above large silver bubble-letter graffiti reading 'ROBBO'. Snowman tags by JFSN appear integrated into the lettering and beside a ventilation unit, overlaid on the multicolored spray-painted background.
work.composition: full-wall mural with overlaid snowman tags
